answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the pearl of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The zephyr lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the basalt is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
